summary: Enhance your MSME's financial knowledge with our specialized training programs. Unlock access to finance and drive your institution's growth today.
lede: MSME access to finance training explores how lenders and finance programs can match funding to businesses’ cash flows and operating cycles. Designed for credit teams, finance managers, program staff and others supporting MSME finance, it helps participants segment businesses, assess repayment capacity through cashflow, and structure suitable facilities such as working capital or asset finance. It also covers risk triggers and portfolio monitoring to support sound financing decisions.
audienceIntro: This course is tailored for professionals involved in designing, managing, delivering, regulating, or supporting MSME finance.
audience: Bank and MFI credit officers, relationship managers
modules: Understanding MSMEs and Why Finance Fails Them
MSME Finance Ecosystem and Institutional Roles
Segmenting MSMEs for Better Finance Decisions
Finance Readiness and Bankability in the Real World
Designing MSME Finance Products That Fit
Alternative Data, Digital Lending, and Practical Credit Scoring
Credit Guarantees, Blended Finance, and De-risking Tools
Value Chain Finance and Supplier Financing Models
Measuring Impact and Performance in MSME Finance
Presenting and Defending MSME Finance Decisions
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of finance and lending principles. Experience in MSME financing or related fields is beneficial but not required.
